description: How a Kafka consumer group splits partitions among its members with the classic protocol (the default in Kafka 4.3): range, roundrobin, sticky or cooperative-sticky, ported from Kafka 4.3.1 and checked against its tests. Returns each member's partitions, idle members and the order the assignor walked them; for the sticky strategies give each member's owned partitions (and generation) to see what moves, and with cooperative-sticky which partitions are revoked this round and handed over in the next. Not covered: rack awareness and the server-side assignors of KIP-848; sticky only when all members subscribe to the same topics.

generation.description: The generation it owned them in (default -1)

groupInstanceId.description: Static membership: changes the order, and so the split

owned.description: sticky strategies: the partitions it had before this rebalance

name: kafka_assign
